description: Game-changer additions on top of the v2 loop. Every story is additive, env-gated, offline-smoke-tested, and never writes outside the loop folder. maestro-core is read-only, always.

userStories.title: Outcome mining: harvest production shadow-review outcomes
userStories.iWant: an outcomes.py that mines what happened to the PRODUCTION AI reviewer's comments on recent merged PRs (acted-on vs dismissed)
userStories.soThat: the loop can learn from live outcomes, not only the historical corpus
acceptanceCriteria: new outcomes.py: fetch AI-reviewer comments + their resolution/reactions for the last LOOP_OUTCOMES_PRS merged PRs via gh (subprocess), identifying the AI bot author by LOOP_AI_REVIEWER_LOGIN (env, with sane default)
classify each finding: acted_on (resolved / author fix commit references it) | dismissed (unresolved + rebuttal reply) | unknown
append-only workspace/outcomes.jsonl with src fingerprints (no duplicates on re-runs); defensive JSON parsing
CLI: python3 loop.py --mine-outcomes runs one pass and prints a summary
smoke: stubbed gh subprocess (LOOP_ALLOW_STUB path or injected fn) proves classification + dedupe offline; smoke stays green

userStories.title: Outcome feedback: dismissed findings become do-not-flag targets, acted-on misses become propose targets
userStories.iWant: outcomes.jsonl wired into the proposer inputs behind LOOP_OUTCOMES=1
userStories.soThat: the rubric learns from real authors accepting or rebutting the AI's findings
acceptanceCriteria: dismissed clusters are offered to propose_edit as false_positives-style input (subtraction pressure), acted_on-but-human-unmatched patterns offered to the corpus-style proposer path
all existing gates unchanged; feature fully off when LOOP_OUTCOMES=0 (default)
ledger records when outcome-derived inputs were used (additive keys only)
smoke: with stub outcomes, prove the proposer prompt receives the outcome sections; smoke stays green

userStories.title: Caught-beyond-humans counter
userStories.iWant: a verified count of AI findings that no human raised and the author still fixed
userStories.soThat: we can prove the reviewer catches what humans missed
acceptanceCriteria: computed from outcomes.jsonl: acted_on findings with no overlapping human comment on the same PR+path window
persisted in state.json (additive key beyond_humans) and exposed in /api/snapshot
dashboard: counter in champion vitals + demo simulator fakes a plausible value
smoke: stubbed outcomes produce the expected count; smoke stays green

userStories.title: Counterfactual replay: champion vs live skill on recent merged PRs
userStories.iWant: replay.py + python3 loop.py --replay N that reviews the last N merged PR diffs with BOTH the live skill and the champion
userStories.soThat: adoption evidence reads 'champion would have caught X bugs the live rubric missed, at +Y noise, on OUR real traffic'
acceptanceCriteria: reuses harness_bridge.evaluate-style review calls with per-case checkpointing semantics (a replay can resume)
writes reports/replay/REPLAY.md: per-PR findings diff (champion-only / live-only / both) + totals; no gating, report only
respects MAX_CALLS_PER_DAY accounting when run via the CLI
smoke: stubbed diffs + reviewer prove the comparison + report rendering offline; smoke stays green

userStories.title: Severity-weighted recall (reported, not gating)
userStories.iWant: a severity-weighted score (critical=4, high=3, medium=2, low=1 via LOOP_SEV_WEIGHTS) computed alongside recall
userStories.soThat: a critical catch is visibly worth more than a nit
acceptanceCriteria: pure function in metrics.py + unit checks in smoke
reported in hourly digests and persisted in state.json (additive); shown in dashboard vitals; decide() UNCHANGED
smoke stays green

userStories.title: Rubric routing by changed-file paths (behind LOOP_ROUTING=1)
userStories.iWant: reviews to load only the reference files whose path globs match the diff (routing map in the skill copy, never in maestro-core)
userStories.soThat: the rubric can grow past the size budget without raising prompt noise
acceptanceCriteria: routing map workspace/champion-skill/routing.json (created/maintained on the COPY only); unmatched files always included as core
LOOP_ROUTING=0 (default) is byte-identical to current behaviour — proven by a smoke equivalence check
with routing on, skill_size budget applies to the ROUTED prompt size per review
smoke stays green
